title: Power Pages: Track Power Pages performance and usage with monitor hub
description:
Power Pages is integrated into the monitor hub. This integration empowers site owners, makers, and administrators to access performance and usage insights directly within the monitor hub of the Power Platform admin center.

Metrics available

The following metrics will be surfaced in monitor hub:

•	Session count: Tracks the number of sessions.

•	Session duration: Measures the average time spent in a session.

•	Page load time: Captures the time it takes for a web page to fully load (P75).

•	Error rate: Measures the percentage of requests where pages become unresponsive or return component-level errors.

Additional capabilities

Additional capabilities include trend visualization and the ability to download detailed reports for further analysis
